lists.name: RYM Top — Rock — Garage Rock Revival

podcast.body: This minimalist garage rock album, described as wild, spontaneous, and heavily influenced by the blues, was their debut record. Released by Sympathy for the Record Industry, it garnered positive critical reception within the underground scene, laying the groundwork for their future success. "De White Stripes, editado por Simpati Ford de Record Industry en 1999, fue su disco de bebut, un álbum de garage rock minimalista, salvaje y espontáneo, y con una fuerte influencia del blues."

srcs.episode: Por qué White Stripes desaparecieron en su mejor momento?

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album was released in 1999, two years after the band's formation, following their signing with Sympathy for the Record Industry, a label highly regarded within the indie community. Similar to The Strokes' debut, it first garnered significant attention in the UK. "That led to a debut self-titled album in 1999, which, like the Strokes' first record, found its initial love in the UK."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
